description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a pumpkin king's, made of a few big bold shapes and no fine pattern: a rounded bright-orange pumpkin doublet that swells a little at the belly, with three broad dark-orange ribs running down it like a pumpkin's, a small collar of teal-green leaves kept below the chin, long deep-violet sleeves to the wrist, a short deep-violet mantle over the shoulders lined in teal-green that ends above the waist, plain dark trousers and black boots. Seen from behind, the short violet mantle covers the shoulders and the orange doublet with its ribs shows below it. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
